5249.title: Android WebView child-layout investigation
5249.rootCauseOneLine: React Native suppresses child layout requests and the patched WebView has no explicit replay; the reported popup symptom remains runtime-unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: No native runtime or focused behavioral regression test was executed.

5249.proposedFix: Measure actual wide-window popup anchor bounds before considering a WebView-owned child-layout replay that preserves assigned bounds.
5249.caveats: Two clean source diagnostics agree, but Java, adb, and emulator are unavailable. No popup was opened, screenshot captured, or linked PR code run. verified refers only to repeatability of the final limited report.
